plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (mapper app https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Map: 'Accounting map for 2026-2027'; program page states 'Catalog 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and Term 1 as 15.5-17 units; the only ranged slot is the Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' choice slot, printed at 3-4.5 units. Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at 3, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum (15.5 / 16 / 15 / 13.5) and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. All other slots print single unit values. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not printed as selections on the map and are not enumerated. The map prints a 'Prerequisites' flag on BSAD B55 and BSAD B54 but does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. The map also prints semester milestone headings (getting started / by end of each semester / after completion) with no further course content; they are not encoded. The map states it represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements, and advises students to make an appointment to create a customized education plan.
